attributes.current:
Cantrips on their own are too simple a spell to reach any height of power. Followers of the school of Forte recognize a method of casting them deemed unorthodox and unstable. They tap into an inner chaos present within their spelldance and the spells they cast, Sacrificing safety and certainty to unlock it's potential to wreak untold amounts of destruction.

Forte Spells[–] You always have certain spells prepared after you reach particular levels in this class, as shown in the Forte Spells table. These spells count as Flickwrist spells for you, but they don't count against the number of Flickwrist spells you prepare.

Forte SpellsLevel | Spell | 
2nd | Fire Bolt,Chaos Bolt | 
7th | Melf's Acid Arrow | 
13th | Lightning Bolt | 
19th | Ice Storm |

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-NykVFuAy8w0LmqFpbh-_description
attributes.current:
As a Flickwrist your specialty is the learning and mastery of movement to cast Cantrips. As you progress through this class you will gain abilities that strengthen and quicken the casting of them.

Cantrips[–] At 1st level, you know four cantrips of your choice from the wizard spell list, they count as Flickwrist cantrips. You learn additional wizard cantrips of your choice at higher levels, as shown in the Cantrips Known column of the Flickwrist table. You may replace a cantrip you know with with another from the wizard spell list when you gain a level in this class.

Spell Slots[–] The Flickwrist spellcasting table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your wizard spells of 1st level and higher. To cast one of these spells, you must expend a slot of the spell's level or higher. You regain all expended spell slots when you finish a long rest. For example, if you know the 1st-level spell shield and have a 1st-level and a 2nd-level spell slot available, you can cast shield using either slot.

Spells Known of 1st-Level and Higher[–] At 1st level, You know three 1st-level wizard spells of your choice. The Spells Known column of the Flickwrist Spellcasting table shows when you learn more wizard spells of 1st level or higher. Each of these spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For instance, when you reach 7th level in this class, you can learn one new spell of 1st or 2nd level.

Whenever you gain a level in this class, you can replace one of the wizard spells you know with another spell of your choice from the wizard spell list. The new spell must be of a level for which you have spell slots.

Spellasting Ability[–] Dexterity is your spellcasting ability for casting spells. Your finesse in its casting determines the spells potency. You use your Dexterity whenever a Spell refers to your Spellcasting ability. You also use your Dexterity modifier when setting the saving throw DC for a Flickwrist Cantrip you cast and when making an attack roll with one.

Spell save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier

Spell attack modifier = your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier

Spellcasting Focus[–] You can use an article of clothing or a worn accessory as a spellcasting focus.

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-NykVFuP88lJCOlDz0yh_description
attributes.current:
At 1st level, choose one of your skill proficiencies, a tool or musical instrument you're proficient with. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of the chosen proficiencies.

At 6th level, you can choose one more of your proficiencies (in skills, tools or musical instruments) to gain this benefit.

attributes.current:
Fluency You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with ranged spell attacks.

Stability[–] When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for a spell you cast, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll, even if the new roll is a 1 or a 2.

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-NykVFuuxGi0bWdQccAX_description
attributes.current:
As you deepen your study of the Choreurgic arts, you begin to discover new intricacies to your step that change how you dance or the way you cast spells.

At the 3rd Level, you gain two Choreurgic Masteries of your choice from the list here. They are powerful abilities that you gain throughout the course of this class as shown in the 'Masteries Known' table.

Additionally when you gain a mastery, you may replace one that you know for another that you meet the requirements for.

You may learn a mastery at the same time that you meet its requirements. If a mastery has a level requirement, you must be a Flickwrist of that level. If you change something about yourself such that you don't meet choreurgic mastery's prerequisites, the mastery and its effects are disabled until its prerequisites are met again or the mastery changed entirely.

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-NykVFv0PYN5VevoKViY_description

Beginning at 5th level, you can cast two cantrips, instead of once, whenever you take the cast a spell action on your turn.

Unless you have the Extra Attack feature, only one of those cantrips cast can involve a weapon attack.

Counting as 4th level spells at the 11 level and 5th level spells at the 17 level.

Cantrips you cast on that turn will have advantage on their attack rolls and they impose disadvantage on saving throws at the cost of 1 damage die rolled from each cantrip cast.

The accuracy of elves is legendary, especially that of elf archers and spellcasters. You have uncanny aim with attacks that rely on precision rather than brute force. You gain the following benefits:

- Whenever you have advantage on an attack roll using Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, you can reroll one of the dice once.

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-NykVQJb963CiqHga3kk_description
attributes.current:
You've received training from magic-users affiliated with the Mages of High Sorcery.

Choose one of the three moons of Krynn to influence your magic: the black moon, Nuitari; the red moon, Lunitari; or the white moon, Solinari. You learn one cantrip of your choice from the wizard spell list and two 1st-level spells based on the moon you choose, as specified in the Lunar Spells table.

Lunar SpellsMoon | 1st-Level Spell | 
Nuitari | Choose two from dissonant whispers, false life, hex, and ray of sickness | 
Lunitari | Choose two from color spray, disguise self, feather fall, and longstrider | 
Solinari | Choose two from comprehend languages, detect evil and good, protection from evil and good, and shield | 
You can cast each of the chosen 1st-level spells without a spell slot, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast them in this way again. You can also cast the spells using any spell slots you have.

Your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (choose when you select this feat).

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-NykVSrZrWkTHvTkFiWa_description
attributes.current: You are a Humanoid. You are also considered an elf for any prerequisite or effect that requires you to be an elf.

As a bonus action, you can magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

Starting at 3rd level, you also gain resistance to all damage when you teleport using this trait. The resistance lasts until the start of your next turn. During that time, you appear ghostly and translucent.

attributes.current:
You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a long rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you retain consciousness.

Whenever you finish this trance, you can gain two proficiencies that you don't have, each one with a weapon or a tool of your choice selected from the Player's Handbook. You mystically acquire these proficiencies by drawing them from shared elven memory, and you retain them until you finish your next long rest.

attributes.current:
You hurl an undulating, warbling mass of chaotic energy at one creature in range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 + 1d6 damage. Choose one of the d8s. The number rolled on that die determines the attack's damage type, as shown below.

Chaos Boltd8 | Damage Type | 
1 | Acid | 
2 | Cold | 
3 | Fire | 
4 | Force | 
5 | Lightning | 
6 | Poison | 
7 | Psychic | 
8 | Thunder | 
If you roll the same number on both d8s, the chaotic energy leaps from the target to a different creature of your choice within 30 feet of it. Make a new attack roll against the new target, and make a new damage roll, which could cause the chaotic energy to leap again.

A creature can be targeted only once by each casting of this spell.

This spell's damage increases by 1d10 when you reach 5th level (2d10), 11th level (3d10), and 17th level (4d10).

attributes.name: repeating_spell-cantrip_-NykkGTRB5DPcSBa-FT0_spelldescription
attributes.current:
You choose an area of water that you can see within range and that fits within a 5-foot cube. You manipulate it in one of the following ways:

- You instantaneously move or otherwise change the flow of the water as you direct, up to 5 feet in any direction. This movement doesn't have enough force to cause damage.

- You cause the water to form into simple shapes and animate at your direction. This change lasts for 1 hour.

- You change the water's color or opacity. The water must be changed in the same way throughout. This change lasts for 1 hour.

- You freeze the water, provided that there are no creatures in it. The water unfreezes in 1 hour.

If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have no more than two of its non-instantaneous effects active at a time, and you can dismiss such an effect as an action.

If the target drops to 0 hit points before this spell ends, you can use a bonus action on a subsequent turn of yours to curse a new creature.

A remove curse cast on the target ends this spell early.

The creature doesn't move into obviously dangerous ground, such as a fire or a pit. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and doesn't have to move away. A deafened creature automatically succeeds on the save.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-cantrip_-Nykuw75VjjGZUQZr-4S_spelldescription
attributes.current:
You create a ghostly, skeletal hand in the space of a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the creature to assail it with the chill of the grave. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 necrotic damage, and it can't regain hit points until the start of your next turn. Until then, the hand clings to the target.

If you hit an undead target, it also has disadvantage on attack rolls against you until the end of your next turn.

This spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

attributes.name: repeating_spell-cantrip_-NykuwckmdSMUeAGCuHK_spellcomp_materials
attributes.current: a melee weapon worth at least 1 sp

attributes.name: repeating_spell-cantrip_-NykuwckmdSMUeAGCuHK_spelldescription
attributes.current:
You brandish the weapon used in the spell's casting and make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects, and you can cause green fire to leap from the target to a different creature of your choice that you can see within 5 feet of it. The second creature takes fire damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.

This spell's damage increases when you reach certain levels. At 5th level, the melee attack deals an extra 1d8 fire damage to the target on a hit, and the fire damage to the second creature increases to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. Both damage rolls increase by 1d8 at 11th level (2d8 and 2d8) and 17th level (3d8 and 3d8).

A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 1d8 cold damage, and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

The spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

attributes.name: repeating_spell-cantrip_-NykuxtvB6gCXyLnBJ3t_spelldescription

Lightning springs from your hand to deliver a shock to a creature you try to touch. Make a melee spell attack against the target. You have advantage on the attack roll if the target is wearing armor made of metal. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 lightning damage, and it can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.

The spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

attributes.name: repeating_spell-cantrip_-NykvCK4x7btavJ8EiSk_spelldescription
attributes.current:
A small firey explosion bursts in your hand producing a strong shockwave behind you. Make a melee spell attack against a creature, dealing 1d10 fire damage on a hit. Regardless of whether this attack hits, any creature within 5 feet in the opposite direction of the attack must succeed a Constitution saving throw or take 1d8 thunder damage

At level 5, the damage increases to 2d10 fire and 2d8 thunder, at level 11 the damage increases to 3d10 fire and 3d8 thunder and at level 17 the damage increases to 4d10 fire and 4d8 thunder

attributes.name: repeating_spell-cantrip_-NykvCmIg1rZIr4PTyGf_spelldescription

Make a melee spell attack against a target within 5 feet If the attack hits, it takes 1d6 necrotic damage as you drain and harden some blood from the creature to shape it into a dart. You then send it flying to a creature you can see within range as a ranged spell attack taking 1d4 piercing damage on a hit. This spell does not work if the first target does not possess blood.

At certain levels, both amounts of damage increase. 2d6 and 2d4 at level 5. 3d6 and 3d4 at level 11. 4d6 and 4d4 at level 17.

attributes.current:
You create an illusion of a weapon in an empty hand that feels all too real to your foes. You may make a melee spell attack with your action, dealing 1d10 psychic damage on a hit or you may make a ranged spell attack against a creature within 30 feet, dealing 1d8 damage on a hit.

The weapon lasts for the duration of the spell or until you let go of it. A creature with truesight is immune to damage from this spell.

At level 5, the psychic damage for the melee and ranged attacks respectively increases to 2d10 and 2d8, at level 11 the damage increases to 3d10 and 3d8 and at level 17 the damage increases to 4d10 and 4d8.

attributes.current: a weapon with which you have proficiency

Guided by a flash of magical insight, you make one attack with the weapon used in the spell’s casting. The attack uses your spellcasting ability for the attack and damage rolls instead of using Strength or Dexterity.

If the attack deals damage, it can be Radiant damage or the weapon’s normal damage type (your choice).

Whether you choose to deal Radiant damage or the weapon’s normal damage type, the attack deals extra Radiant damage when you reach levels 5 (1d6), 11 (2d6), and 17 (3d6).
